title: Class resource capacities: reconcile selected tracked counters (e.g. Rage, Ki, Sorcery Points) with pack resourceProgression at level-up
acceptance_criteria:
- Recorded classification of every source-backed resourceProgression column (capacity vs damage bonus / dice scaling / speed / descriptive), with the selected counters named and justified by a gameplay consumer.
- Representative progression: a tracked character ability counter used before level-up (e.g. Barbarian Rage with one use spent at level 2) shows the correct new maximum after level-up, with used uses preserved and no free restoration unless the SRD requires it.
- Selected class resources cannot be minted with a model-declared max that disagrees with the pack.
- No double economy (one counter per resource per character) and no regression of creature record-derived or item counters (existing usageCounters tests stay green).
- Ledger change set records the capacity change.
notes: PR opened (head 21b99cd4) 2026-10-09; supervisor added alias-aware findCounter fix + regression; verify green. Stays in_progress until merge. Follow-up eshyra-fa54.
